verdict.line: You lose if Renekton gets free autos into a level 2-5 W stun combo before you can kite; you win once you hit 6 and can out-range him with Q and threaten the R execute.

brief.thesis: Renekton's kit is entirely short-range (300-450) while Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) hits from 800 — the whole lane is a fight over whether Renekton closes that gap before his Fury-empowered W (Ruthless Predator) comes online. Early levels favor him because his point-and-click stun and Q sustain punish melee trades; from level 6 onward Urgot's R (Fear Beyond Death) threat and poke range close the gap, which is why the head-to-head sits at 51.3% over 1222 games despite Renekton holding the lane-phase advantage.

theirWindow.when: Fury is above 50 and W is ready
theirWindow.what: At 50+ Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) upgrades to three slashes, destroys your shields, and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s — this is his full burst window. Disengage rather than trade face to face if you see his Fury bar topped off.

yourWindow.when: his W and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: W (Ruthless Predator, 16-8s CD) and E (Slice and Dice, 16-10s CD) are his only tools to close distance or stun you; when both are down, poke freely with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, 10-8s CD) since he has to walk the full gap in melee range with no answer.

start.why: The highest-picked start (88%, 50.7% WR over 1285 games) — the attack damage and sustain help you win the trades where you're forced into melee range during Purge (W), since Renekton's Q (Cull the Meek) heal rewards him for staying close.

boots.why: 76.4% pick, 50.8% WR over 1062 games — flat damage reduction blunts Renekton's basic attacks, which is exactly how he builds Fury toward his empowered W and Q.

core.why: Stacking armor shred from your Q and Purge autos keeps your damage relevant as Renekton's bruiser build adds resistances.
Bonus health and a damage shield at low HP let you survive his W (Ruthless Predator) burst window instead of getting chain-stunned down.
Stacking resistances scale you into extended fights, outlasting Renekton once his R (Dominus) transformation window ends.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive autos/Q hits before Renekton can close in and stun you, which is the core trade pattern of this lane (51.4% WR, 30.9% pick).

summoners.why: 83.4% pick, 51.1% WR — Ignite cuts through the healing from Renekton's Q (Cull the Meek) during all-ins, and Flash lets you dodge his W (Ruthless Predator) stun combo once his Fury is topped off.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee
playing.detail: Q (Corrosive Charge) outranges every Renekton tool at 800 vs his 300-450 kit range — land it and back off before he closes, denying him the autos that build Fury.

playing.title: Track the Fury threshold
playing.detail: Past 50 Fury his Q heals and damages more and his W triples its slashes while destroying shields. Force trades only when his Fury is freshly spent, not stacked.

playing.title: Hold Purge for his commitment
playing.detail: Don't dump W (Purge) at max range for poke; save it to burst back once he actually walks in and commits E (Slice and Dice) or W (Ruthless Predator) on you.

playing.title: Use Disdain on the dash
playing.detail: E (Disdain) shields you and, if it catches a champion, stops and hurls them out of the way — use it the instant he lands Slice and Dice to shove him back out before his stun follow-up.

playing.title: Respect level 3-5 all-ins
playing.detail: His point-and-click W stun comes online at level 2 and spikes hard with points invested by level 3-5. Play for chip trades, not all-ins, until level 6.

playing.title: Threaten with R past level 6
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death, 2500 range) impales and threatens execute on low-health targets — this alone should push him off aggressive dives once you're both 6+.

playing.title: Shred through his tankiness
playing.detail: Rush Black Cleaver stacks so your Q and Purge damage stay relevant as his Fury-fueled bruiser build adds resistances in the mid game.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns explaining why those numbers look this way are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Fight Renekton after checking his Fury. Keep in mind that his reinforced (W) can go nullify your shield.
